VALOR_DA_MENSAGEM.ENVIADA: from the team to the customer

PASSOS.CONVERSA_ETIQUETAS: Add or remove a conversation label
PASSOS.CONTATO_ETIQUETAS: Add or remove a contact label
PASSOS.MENSAGEM: Send a message to the customer
PASSOS.EXTRAIR: AI pulls data from the conversation

CAMPOS.NAME: Name
CAMPOS.TITLE: Label name
CAMPOS.TROCAR: Replace what was already filled in

AUTOMACAO_LIVRE.LIGOU: On. From now on it works by itself.
AUTOMACAO_LIVRE.DESLIGOU: Off. Nothing else happens through it.
AUTOMACAO_LIVRE.MUDOU: Someone changed this automation. See the new version before going on.
AUTOMACAO_LIVRE.FALHOU: That did not work right now. Try again.

LISTA.SUBTITULO: Everything that happens by itself in your account, in one place.
LISTA.ANTIGAS: 1 still the old way | {n} still the old way
LISTA.MAIS_PASSOS: and 1 more step | and {n} more steps
LISTA.ERRO: Could not load the automations right now.
LISTA.DO_FUNIL: Pipeline stage automations live in Configure › Edit pipeline.

EDITOR.NO_MEIO: Whoever already started finishes on the previous version.
EDITOR.PAUSOU: It paused because someone else saved. To go on, turn it on again.
EDITOR.NAO_ACHOU: This automation no longer exists or belongs to another account.
EDITOR.NAO_SALVA: Complete the missing step to be able to save.
EDITOR.LIGADA_AVISO: This automation is on. Your changes only take effect when you tap Save all.
EDITOR.LIGADA_POR_OUTRA: Someone else turned this automation on. When you tap Save all, it pauses until it is turned on again.

SAIR.TEXTO: Your changes are not saved yet. If you leave now, they go away.

EDITOR.RASCUNHO: You have changes that are not saved yet.
EDITOR.CONFLITO: Someone else saved first. Your changes were not saved.

CONFIRA.AVANCADA_DICA: Only the Guide changes this step. Here it stays as it is.

ETIQUETAS_CONVERSA.POR: Add the label {lista} to the conversation
ETIQUETAS_CONVERSA.POR_VARIAS: Add the labels {lista} to the conversation
ETIQUETAS_CONVERSA.TIRAR: Remove the label {lista} from the conversation
ETIQUETAS_CONVERSA.TIRAR_VARIAS: Remove the labels {lista} from the conversation
ETIQUETAS_CONVERSA.POR_E_TIRAR: On the conversation, add {por} and remove {tirar}

ETIQUETAS_CONTATO.POR: Add the label {lista} to the contact
ETIQUETAS_CONTATO.POR_VARIAS: Add the labels {lista} to the contact
ETIQUETAS_CONTATO.TIRAR: Remove the label {lista} from the contact
ETIQUETAS_CONTATO.TIRAR_VARIAS: Remove the labels {lista} from the contact
ETIQUETAS_CONTATO.POR_E_TIRAR: On the contact, add {por} and remove {tirar}

FRASES.EXTRAIR: AI looks in the conversation for: {lista}
FRASES.ESCREVER_MENSAGEM: AI writes and sends to the customer: “{instrucao}”
FRASES.ESCREVER_SUGESTAO: AI writes a suggestion for the team: “{instrucao}”
FRASES.RESUMIR_NOTA: AI summarizes the conversation in a note
FRASES.RESUMIR_AVISAR: AI summarizes the conversation and notifies {quem}

SELETOR.TEXTO: It goes where the “+” you tapped is.

ALTERAR_PAINEL.COMPOSTA: This condition has several parts. Only the Guide changes it; here it stays as is.
ALTERAR_PAINEL.BUSCA_FALHOU: Could not search right now. Try again.
ALTERAR_PAINEL.TEXTO_DICA: Anything in brackets, like [Contact name], is replaced by the detail at that moment. If the detail is empty, this step does not happen.
ALTERAR_PAINEL.SO_A_EQUIPE: Only the team sees this notice. The customer gets nothing.
ALTERAR_PAINEL.TEM_DADO_APAGADO: A detail in this text was deleted from the account. Remove it or swap it for another: as it is, Save all will not accept it.
ALTERAR_PAINEL.FILTRO_ENTRA: When you save, "Only if" gets: {condicao}. You can change or remove it later.
ALTERAR_PAINEL.FILTRO_SAI: When you save, "Only if" loses: {condicao}. It only works with "When a message arrives".

LIGAR.DESLIGADA: It is off. Nothing happens until you turn it on.
LIGAR.FALTA_PASSO: Still missing at least one step.
LIGAR.SO_LEITURA: You can see this automation. To change it, ask who looks after automations.
LIGAR.FALTA_COMPLETAR: A step is incomplete: choose the condition and, in "If", add at least one step under Then.

LEITURAS.MENSAGENS_COM_RESPOSTAS: The latest customer and team messages
LEITURAS.ULTIMA_MENSAGEM: The message that started the automation
LEITURAS.CONVERSA: Channel, inbox, labels and status of the conversation
LEITURAS.CONTATO: Contact name and fields (never email or phone)

CAMINHO.DICA: From 2 to 8 paths. When the conversation is unclear, the AI picks “None applies” instead of guessing.

CAMPO.DICA: The AI fills in only what is written in the conversation. If it is not there, the field stays empty and the history says so.

DESTINOS.SUGESTAO: Leave as a suggestion for the team to review
